prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: simplified visual direction concept sheet for an actual HTML Canvas 2D game.
Primary request: Simplify the Enchanted Ink warm calm storybook direction radically. Create a VERY SIMPLE flat 2D game concept, strict orthographic overhead top-down camera, perfectly straight down at horizontal ground. This is production guidance for a small HTML Canvas prototype built with circles, rectangles, polygons and strokes, not elaborate concept painting.
Composition: wide landscape board, warm parchment background. Left: large portrait 9:16 gameplay screenshot, strict bird's-eye plan view of a circular forest arena connected to a straight corridor at its top. Right: three compact overhead tile samples labeled "FOREST", "CAVE", "LIBRARY", plus a small primitive wizard construction study and wand/rune symbols. Bottom six palette swatches labeled exactly #182C28 #496B4A #B8C88D #E9DDBB #C58A45 #EF795E. Title exactly "ENCHANTED INK / SIMPLE 2D".
Rendering rules: flat solid colors, no gradients, no realistic lighting, no glow, no paper grain within game artwork, no brush textures, no detailed stone bricks, no 3D, no isometric, no angled camera, no horizon, no visible vertical walls or side faces, no perspective whatsoever. Each prop max 2-3 simple shapes, each character max 5-6 shapes, trees circular scalloped green canopy blobs from overhead, stone obstacles simple rounded slate polygons, floor large uninterrupted pale sage flat region. Arena boundary thick dark moss green outline, surroundings muted green. Only 3 trees and 3 stones near arena edges, no dense decoration, no tiny foliage, no complex ruins. Huge breathing room and readable silhouettes.
Player overhead wizard: round warm coral hood with a small darker face opening facing upward, tiny shoulders, one short brass wand extending diagonally; compact icon scale, no tall front-facing standing character. Enemies two small dark green round goblin silhouettes with triangular ears and pale eyes, one bone-white simple skeleton icon. A tiny coral-orange circular fire projectile with two short trail strokes. Rune pickup small brass diamond with one carved symbol.
HUD minimalist simple parchment rounded rectangles: health top, a subtle joystick ring bottom left, two small square wand/rune slots bottom right. Labels English only. No minimap or extra UI. Calm approachable warm palette, slightly irregular clean outlines, restrained handmade charm expressed by shape not texture. Forest sample overhead green blobs; Cave sample overhead muted stone polygons; Library sample overhead rectangular brown shelves with only 3 book stripes, no shelf side faces. This must look like a real modest flat Canvas game, NOT an illustrated fantasy environment.
